title: Same-Day Change Fee Posting on the Ticket Service-Fee Ledger
content:
**Call center ledger reference — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** This entry governs the same-day change fee owed for the latest same-day confirmed exchange recorded on a ticket.

## When the fee is owed

- The fee concerns the **latest same-day confirmed exchange** recorded on the ticket's fare history.
- The fee is owed while no same-day change fee entry is linked to that exchange, whether or not the customer raises it.
- It is posted through the call center as one same-day change fee entry linked to that exchange entry.
- A fee worked out at zero is not recorded, and an exchange whose fee works out at zero owes no same-day change fee.

| Records on the ticket (hypothetical) | Same-day change fee owed |
|---|---|
| Latest same-day exchange, no same-day change fee entry linked to it, fee works out above zero | Yes, one entry linked to that exchange |
| Latest same-day exchange already carries its linked same-day change fee entry | No further entry |
| Latest same-day exchange, fee works out at zero | Nothing owed and nothing recorded |

## The posting tool

`post_same_day_change_fee_61b8e8ae` is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it and then calls it; the customer does not run it. It books one same-day change fee charge on the ticket's service-fee ledger, linked to the same-day exchange entry it is charged for, at the amount given, paid through the call center. The ticket's net fee charges rise by that amount and the charge is visible on the ticket's service fees straight away. One call books exactly one charge.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ticket_id` | Reference number of the ticket record the fee is charged on, as returned by the ticket lookup for this customer | Identifier |
| `related_transaction_id` | Reference number of the same-day exchange entry on the ticket's fare history that the fee is charged for, as returned by the fare-history lookup | Identifier |
| `corporate_account_id` | Reference number of the corporate travel agreement the ticket names, copied from the ticket record's corporate agreement field; an empty string when the ticket names no agreement | Identifier or empty string |
| `fee_amount` | The same-day change fee charged | US dollars, a non-negative number rounded to the cent (2 decimal places) before it is passed |

### Return

A receipt with `service_id` (reference number of the new fee charge), `ticket_id`, `related_transaction_id` (the exchange entry charged for), `service_type` (always `same_day_change_fee`), `amount` (the fee booked, US dollars to 2 decimal places), `service_date` (business date of the charge, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status` ("posted" when the charge was booked).

*Hypothetical call.* For a fee of 48.75 dollars on a ticket naming no corporate agreement, `corporate_account_id` is passed as an empty string and `fee_amount` as 48.75; the receipt returns `status` "posted" and an `amount` of 48.75.
